terrain.runnerLimits: Initial capture race stopped first run. Corrected second run completed both six-view extended arms, then stopped on an excessive map-only-high outside-rectangle assertion. Actual altitude-expanded rectangle covered the whole authored map. Independent corrected map-only six-view run passed. Those failures are preserved, not relabelled as complete passing campaigns.

profile.policy: Legacy-density mode explicitly zeros new controls and freezes world-ASL slabs from actual baseline height. Terrain mode uses AGL slabs with actual C++ startup terrain/patch defaults; trace records packed controls. OFF scout used built-in profiles; disabled optics are independent of profile.

fog.scope: Actual original Everon and authoritative weather, same XYZ camera requests, unchanged native source/ranges at equal weather. Encoded trace is CPU command readiness. Per-view frame_performance receipts contain latest asynchronous published GPU timers, without sampled GPU frame ID or exact screenshot-frame attribution. Frame total is inclusive; fog transport excludes background/consumer/weather-map costs. No timer summation, steady statistical benchmark, uncontended cost certification, visual acceptance or default promotion claimed. Terrain mode is an explicit experiment; no quality/cost acceptance is claimed.
